mapper.sql: id, student_id, teaching_class_id, batch_id, status, selected_at, withdrawn_at, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select:
SELECT cs.id, cs.student_id, cs.teaching_class_id, cs.batch_id, cs.status, cs.selected_at, cs.withdrawn_at, cs.created_at, cs.updated_at FROM course_selection cs JOIN teaching_class tc ON tc.id = cs.teaching_class_id
ORDER BY cs.id DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM course_selection cs JOIN teaching_class tc ON tc.id = cs.teaching_class_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO course_selection (student_id, teaching_class_id, batch_id, status, selected_at) VALUES (#{studentId}, #{teachingClassId}, #{batchId}, #{status}, #{selectedAt})
